title: Europe coverage evidence tranche 1B - Denmark, Netherlands, Belgium, France, Ireland

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Danish Immigration Service operates nyidanmark.dk/en-GB as the official English-language portal for foreign nationals who wish to visit, live or work in Denmark or Greenland.
The Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND) operates ind.nl/en as the official English-language portal for residency in the Netherlands.
The Belgian Federal Public Service Foreign Affairs operates diplomatie.belgium.be/en as the official English-language portal for Belgian foreign affairs, consular services and travel information.
The French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs operates diplomatie.gouv.fr/en as the official English-language portal for French foreign affairs, including visiting France and visa services.
The Irish Immigration Service Delivery (ISD) operates irishimmigration.ie as the official portal for immigration to Ireland.

batch.name: v10.22.15 Europe evidence tranche 1B - DK, NL, BE, FR, IE
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Denmark (DK), Netherlands (NL), Belgium (BE), France (FR) and Ireland (IE). All five endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable immigration, visa, residence or travel content. The tranche is intentionally limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Danish Immigration Service official English portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Danish Immigration Service operates nyidanmark.dk/en-GB as the official English-language portal for foreign nationals who wish to visit, live or work in Denmark or Greenland. This supports a proposal that Denmark directly administers the relevant immigration services through the Danish Immigration Service.
